correctness.rationale: Direct substitution proves the two nonidentifiable boundary faces and the improper double-zero point. For positive scales, writing the cumulative hazard plus one as \(e^{a x^\eta}+b x^\varphi\) lets the exponential term recover \(\eta\) and \(a\) from two asymptotic limits; exact subtraction then recovers \(\varphi\) and \(b\). Growth separation excludes coincidences between the interior, pure-Weibull, and pure-exponential-power strata.

value.rationale: Identifiability is treated by the target as a foundational structural property before inference. The result gives the natural complete repair: it identifies the maximal four-parameter domain, classifies every boundary face as a lower-dimensional model, and removes the double-zero point that is not a finite lifetime law. This is more than a single counterexample and also explains why the later strictly-positive Bayesian specification avoids the defect.
